summary: Advocates for continuation and expansion of E-Rate funding to ensure continued access to technology resources for education.

claims.argument: Any reduction or elimination of E-Rate funding would significantly harm the district by forcing a deep retrenchment of critical digital resources
claims.evidence_quote: The financial disruption caused by changes to the E-Rate program would be immediate and severe. Clay County District Schools recently entered a new five-year funding cycle, securing multi-year procurement contracts to ensure predictable costs and maximum service quality. A sudden reduction or termination of E-Rate support would leave our district fully liable for these long-term financial commitments, shifting millions of dollars in unexpected liabilities onto our local general budget.
